title: 60-Minute Toronto Luxury Yacht Sightseeing Prosecco Cruise!
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
This cruise of the Toronto Harbour gives you the chance to enjoy scenic views of the Toronto skyline while enjoying a glass of prosecco. Enjoy incredible views of the city, island parklands, waterways and more!

Your fully-licensed Captain will show you the sights including the Western Harbour Castle Hotel, The Lagoons and the Toronto Islands. On our way out into the harbour you can spot the Harbourfront Centre, CN Tower, Rogers Centre, Sugar Beach, the Redpath Sugar Refinery, and the historic Gibraltar Point Lighthouse. 

For an additional one hour other sites featured on this part can also include a tour of historic Hanlan’s Point, the Island Yacht Club, Toronto Island channels, and the woodlands of the Island Bird and Wildlife Sanctuary.

Enjoy the scenery from the luxury of our rear outdoor seating area or relax and sunbathe on the front deck of the 44 feet cruiser yacht!
